thread:
incident-bot: ALERT -> 3xx increase in gateway timeouts and 5xx errors across us-east-1 inference cluster. Alert group: scheduler.queue_latency_high, batching.saturation. Paging sre-oncall-jenn :pager:
sre-oncall-jenn: On it. Can someone add quick customer impact numbers?
product-cs-alex: Seeing support queue blow up — ~8% of API calls failing with 504/523 in last 10m. A few paying customers reported degraded UX.
runtime-eng-owen: Logs show scheduler backlog growing; batches stuck waiting for slot allocation. head-of-line style blocking in scheduler pooling. Samples:
```
2026-03-15T18:10:12Z WARN scheduler: queue_len=1425; oldest=00:03:47; dispatch_rate=0.6/s
2026-03-15T18:11:03Z ERROR gateway: upstream_timeout: context deadline exceeded
```
infra-oncall-raj: Are we auto-scaling? Pool shows 2/5 nodes healthy. Autoscaler didn't spin new nodes due to image-pull throttling.
sre-oncall-jenn: Ok immediate mitigation plan: (1) throttle incoming non-critical traffic at gateway, (2) increase scheduler worker count if possible, (3) enable bypass for small requests so they don't get batched, (4) fall back failing requests to smaller model variant. Who can run the scale?
infra-oncall-raj: I can. Pushing a temporary scale and disabling image pull limit for nodepool. Running: `kubectl scale deploy/scheduler --replicas=6 -n redwood-prod`
deploy-bot: Deploy job started: scale scheduler -> 6 replicas (id: deploy-6942). Estimated 60s.
runtime-eng-owen: While that comes up, can we reduce batch aggregation window from 50ms -> 10ms? That will reduce HOL blocking but increase token cost. Patch sending to runtime config: `batch.window_ms=10`
sre-oncall-jenn: Do it. Also enable request-size bypass route: small requests bypass batching. Tilly, can support flag customers about short-term degraded latency?
support-tilly: Yep, posting to status page and reaching out to top 10 accounts flagged by CS. Draft status: "We are investigating increased errors/timeouts in US-East affecting model responses. Mitigations in progress." Will post in 5.
runtime-eng-owen: Pushed batch window change. Command used: `curl -X POST https://runtime-config/api/v1/update -d '{"batch.window_ms":10}'`
infra-oncall-raj: New scheduler pods are spinning up. Nodepool autoscale corrected by temporarily ignoring image pull throttle.
sre-oncall-jenn: Observability — token-level traces? any pattern like long-lived connections holding KV cache?
runtime-eng-owen: Some batches were waiting on large embedding jobs (customer A) — they were getting prioritized incorrectly and blocking small chat requests. Implementing priority eviction for >5s queued jobs now.
product-cs-alex: Customer A notified — they are running a heavy backfill. Asked them to pause for 30m.
sre-oncall-jenn: Gateway short-term rate-limit: applying 10% global ingress throttling for downstream non-paid tiers. Command: `gatewayctl throttle set --global 10% --exclude=paid`
deploy-bot: Throttle change applied (id: throttle-237).
runtime-eng-owen: Early metrics: queue length dropped from 1425 -> 310 in 90s. 5xx rate trending down from 8% -> 2.1%. Timeouts reduced but still above baseline.
support-tilly: Status page updated: ongoing mitigations, partial relief reported.
infra-oncall-raj: Completed a rolling restart of 2 older scheduler pods to clear stale KV handles.
sre-oncall-jenn: Good. Next: set preemptive eviction threshold to drop any queue entries older than 45s for non-critical routes. Owen, can you push that?
runtime-eng-owen: Pushed preemptive_eviction.max_age=45s for non-critical. Also enabling fallback route to quantized-96 model for standard-generation route: `routing.fallback = model:open-q-96`
sre-oncall-jenn: Customer impact check in 10m. Any remaining hotspots?
product-cs-alex: A handful of paid customers still seeing slow responses; CS triaging with one-on-one. No data exfiltration.
sre-oncall-jenn: Okay we'll keep this channel for live updates. If 5xx < 1% and timeouts ~ baseline for 10m, we'll de-escalate.
runtime-eng-owen: Metrics now: 5xx=0.9%, gateway timeouts ~ 0.7% over last 5m. Queue length stable ~120.
support-tilly: Posting update: mitigations successful, partial relief, teams monitoring.
incident-bot: Pager cleared for this alert group (duration: 00:22:30).
sre-oncall-jenn: Marking as mitigated. Postmortem owner: @runtime-eng-owen. Please capture root cause: scheduler saturation due to heavy long-running backfills + autoscaler fail to add nodes due to image pull throttle. Action items: 1) Autoscaler resiliency fix, 2) route-level backpressure knobs, 3) improve alerting thresholds to catch queue growth earlier, 4) customer backfill detection and proactive throttling.
product-cs-alex: I'll coordinate customer communications + credits if needed.
runtime-eng-owen: Started a runbook draft in docs/incidents. Will include exact commands and metric cutoffs.
sre-oncall-jenn: Thanks everyone. Channel clear unless further regressions. :white_check_mark:
